Exploitation requires that the attacker coerce the target user into opening a malicious .XLS file. The specific flaw exists during the processing of malformed charts embedded within a Word document. title: Microsoft Word Malformed Chart Code Execution Vulnerability

Exploitation requires that the attacker coerce the target user into opening a malicious .XLS file. The specific flaw exists during the processing of malformed charts embedded within a Word document.
